subject: Re: Kickoff: dual-pixel depth for the imaging pipeline
body:
Decisions for Monday's integration review:

1. We take the slightly larger student. Linnea's inverse-depth weighting closed most of the far-range gap, but the last bit costs 1.8ms over the original latency budget — and Saoirse's runtime numbers show we can absorb that by moving the preprocessing to the ISP path. 11x smaller than DPNet, quality within tolerance on all affine-invariant metrics.
2. Relighting scopes to confident-anchor captures per Fumiko's proposal; defocus is unconditional. This is the story we take to the imaging platform team.
3. Scope cut: no low-light specialization this half. The dataset skews well-lit and I won't promise what we haven't measured.
4. Distillation recipe gets written up as a reusable asset under Linnea's name — it's the piece I expect other vision teams to come asking for.

See you Monday.

Lucia
